descriptionChirho: The proper noun Mattityahu/Mattithiah, a theophoric name meaning 'gift of YHWH', borne by several Levites and other figures in the Hebrew Bible (1 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah). All four clusters refer to the same name with only orthographic and grammatical variation: with conjunction waw (S115352, S115355), bare name in short form Mattityah (S115353), and longer form Mattityahu with/without conjunction (S115354). Multilingual evidence uniformly confirms one referent name: eng 'Mattityahu/Mattithiah', spa 'Matitias/Matatias', hin 'mattityah/mattityahu' (मत्तित्याह/मत्तित्याहू), arb 'Mattithya/Mattithyahu' (مَتِّيثْيا/مَتِّيثْيَاهُو), kor 'Mattinya/Matitiya' (맛데니야/마티티야), swa 'Matithia/Matithiya'.
